title: NIST Releases Test Tools to Accelerate Adoption of Emerging Route Leak Mitigation Standards
summary: NIST has released NIST BGP RPKI IO (BRIO) - an open-source test tool and data sets to facilitate testing and experimentation with emerging Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) security and resilience mechanisms that leverage the Resource Public Key
author: Doug Montgomery
title_norm: nist releases test tools to accelerate adoption of emerging route leak mitigation standards
